comparison.objective: Test a seat-belt retractor by slow pull, jerk-triggered locking, and rewind; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop, then cycles it.
comparison.physical_skill: Speed-modulated webbing pulling and release versus concentric driver/wrench seating, countertorque, and jam-nut locking.
comparison.success_condition: Requires 150 mm steady payout, lock within 15 mm after a jerk, rewind, and clearance; candidate requires a retained 90° setting, seated nuts, three repeat cycles, low drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: The record tests velocity-dependent retractor behavior, not preservation of an adjusted screw setting while tightening a locknut.
